content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment processors often impose high fees and restrictions that can cripple a creator's profitability. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This drastic difference means that for 100 sales of a $97 product, you would retain $921 more using NOWPayments. This infrastructure allows you to own your sales process completely, free from the limitations and fees of conventional platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you’ll need a few essential components. Start with a domain name and hosting service, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which are free. You'll also require a backend logic service like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for processing. Next, set up a database for order storage using Supabase or even Google Sheets. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing to handle all transactions securely.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your infrastructure in place, the next step is to connect your payment and delivery systems. Use NOWPayments to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, ensuring that your customers have flexibility in how they pay. After payment confirmation, set up automated scripts using Google Apps Scripts or Cloudflare Workers to deliver digital products directly to customers. This seamless process enhances customer experience and ensures that you retain full control over your sales.
Retain more revenue by cutting out platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With everything set up, it’s time to go live. Make sure to test your payment and delivery pipeline thoroughly before announcing your store. Process a few test transactions to ensure that everything works smoothly—from payment confirmation to product delivery. Once satisfied, promote your store through your networks. Encourage feedback to identify areas for improvement. Your first sale marks not just a transaction but the beginning of your independent commerce journey.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is operational, focus on scaling your offerings. You can easily add more products to your store without incurring additional fees. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to enhance your digital offerings. Consider expanding your product range or targeting wider audiences through marketing strategies. The sovereign infrastructure allows you to grow without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your delivery pipeline for seamless transactions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Purchase a domain name to establish your online presence. Select a free hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. Test your payment and delivery pipeline. Launch your store and promote it through your networks.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can sell an ebook online by using a combination of free hosting services and NOWPayments for crypto payments. This allows you to avoid traditional payment processors and retain full ownership of your sales.

Utilizing a sovereign commerce infrastructure allows you to sell digital downloads without high platform fees. NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, providing significant savings compared to other platforms.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own online store using free tools and integrating NOWPayments. This gives you full control over your sales and eliminates reliance on platforms like Gumroad.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins, providing flexibility for your customers.
How can I automate product delivery after a purchase?
You can automate product delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Set up scripts to send digital products to customers immediately after payment confirmation.
